```{r}
if (parset == 'local') {
  plan(multisession)
}

if (parset == 'gandalf') {
  plan(list(tweak(future.batchtools::batchtools_slurm,
                template = "batchtools.slurm.tmpl",
                resources = list(time = 60,
```

Set up. I'm still trying to decide how much of this is general and how much bespoke.

```{r}
runlist <- chunks_to_process(out_dir = datOut,
                               dataname = '',# Short circuit, just test the full list
                               summaryFun = 'diversity', 
                               nchunks = 1,
                               catchment = 'all',
                               returnForR = TRUE,
                               filetype = '.rds')
```

Do the runs

```{r}
source('R/anae_diversity.R')

with_progress({
p <- progressor(steps = nrow(runlist))
diversity_all <- foreach(nl = 1:nrow(runlist),
                  .combine = rbind,
                  .errorhandling = 'remove',
                  .options.future = list(
                    seed = TRUE)) %dofuture% { 

                          # get the looplevels
  w <- runlist$catchment[nl]
    diversity_responses <- anae_diversity(out_dir = datOut, 
                                strictname = 'diversity',
                          dataname = 'inundation',
                          summaryFun = 'areaInun05cm',
                          catchment = w,
                          thischunk = 1, 
                          nchunks = 1,
                          saveout = TRUE, 
                          returnForR = FALSE)
    
    p(glue::glue('catchment {w}'))
                    }
})
```
